SELECT se.id AS schedule_event_id,
    se.date,
    se.venue,
    se.scenario,

    COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN r.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'confirmed'::text]) THEN r.participant_count
            ELSE 0
        END), 0::bigint) AS current_reservations,
    COALESCE(se.max_participants - sum(
        CASE
            WHEN r.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'confirmed'::text]) THEN r.participant_count
            ELSE 0
        END), se.max_participants::bigint) AS available_seats,
    count(
        CASE
            WHEN r.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'confirmed'::text]) THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS reservation_count
   FROM schedule_events se
     LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.schedule_event_id = se.id
  GROUP BY se.id, se.date, se.venue, se.scenario, se.start_time, se.end_time, se.max_participants;

WITH internal_counts AS (
         SELECT schedule_events.scenario_master_id,
            count(*) AS performance_count
           FROM schedule_events
          WHERE schedule_events.is_cancelled = false AND (schedule_events.category = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'private'::text, 'gmtest'::text]))
          GROUP BY schedule_events.scenario_master_id
        ), external_counts AS (
         SELECT external_performance_reports.scenario_master_id,
            sum(external_performance_reports.performance_count)::integer AS performance_count
           FROM external_performance_reports
          WHERE external_performance_reports.status = 'approved'::text
          GROUP BY external_performance_reports.scenario_master_id
        ), license_rates AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT organization_scenarios.scenario_master_id,
            COALESCE(organization_scenarios.license_amount, 0) AS license_amount
           FROM organization_scenarios
        )
 SELECT sm.id AS scenario_master_id,
    sm.title AS scenario_title,
    sm.author,
    COALESCE(lr.license_amount, 0) AS license_amount,
    COALESCE(ic.performance_count, 0::bigint) AS internal_performance_count,
    COALESCE(ec.performance_count, 0) AS external_performance_count,
    COALESCE(ic.performance_count, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(ec.performance_count, 0) AS total_performance_count,
    (COALESCE(ic.performance_count, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(ec.performance_count, 0)) * COALESCE(lr.license_amount, 0) AS total_license_fee
   FROM scenario_masters sm
     LEFT JOIN license_rates lr ON lr.scenario_master_id = sm.id
     LEFT JOIN internal_counts ic ON ic.scenario_master_id = sm.id
     LEFT JOIN external_counts ec ON ec.scenario_master_id = sm.id;
